requirements.requirement: Flight data provider abstraction layer supporting multiple adapters (FastFlights, Amadeus, SerpApi) with consistent normalized output contract.
requirements.user_outcome: Users discover flight opportunities aggregated reliably across multiple sources without provider format lock-in.
acceptance: Provider interface defines search, refresh, and health-check capabilities.
Raw provider payloads are transformed into the internal normalized flight offer contract.
Missing optional provider fields have safe defaults without crashing normalization.
required_evidence: Provider adapter tests for Amadeus and FastFlights

requirements.requirement: Strict flight data validation and anomalous fare rejection.
requirements.user_outcome: Users never see impossible flights (departure after arrival, negative prices, zero prices, missing route codes).
acceptance: Rejects fares with price <= 0 or non-finite values.
Rejects flights where arrival is earlier than departure or flight duration is <= 0.
Requires valid IATA/ICAO origin and destination codes.
Validates departure and return dates as legitimate future calendar dates.

requirements.requirement: Immutable historical fare observation ingestion with idempotent deduplication.
requirements.user_outcome: Historical price tracking accurately reflects real market movements without duplicate inflation.
acceptance: Stores each fare observation with route, dates, airline, price, currency, timestamp, and provider.
Deduplication key prevents identical offer re-insertion on repeated pipeline runs.
Raw observations are append-only to preserve statistical integrity.

requirements.requirement: Adaptive query economics and scan scheduling preventing Cartesian explosion.
requirements.user_outcome: Background flight monitoring remains sustainable, respecting API rate limits and quotas while capturing high-value deals.
acceptance: Scheduled worker scans prioritized route batches rather than global Cartesian product.
Configurable cache TTLs prevent redundant immediate re-queries.
Worker respects rate limits with backoff and jitter.

requirements.requirement: Offline provider fixture replay and regression suite.
requirements.user_outcome: The system can be tested and verified reproducibly without consuming external provider quotas.
acceptance: Representative JSON fixtures for all supported providers are maintained in test folders.
Parsers and normalizers execute cleanly against fixture data in automated CI.
required_evidence: Fixture test executions in vitest and deno test suites

requirements.requirement: Fare comparison cohorts with hierarchical fallback.
requirements.user_outcome: Prices are compared fairly against similar flights (same route, cabin, seasonality, lead-time bucket) rather than unlike fares.
acceptance: Cohorts group fares by route, trip type (one-way vs round-trip), and lead-time window.
When sample size in a granular cohort is below threshold, falls back to route-level baseline with reduced confidence.
Cohort quality explicitly influences deal confidence.
required_evidence: Database aggregation logic in analyze-price function

requirements.requirement: Robust statistical pricing engine.
requirements.user_outcome: Market price baselines use robust statistics (median, percentiles, dispersion) unaffected by single wild outliers.
acceptance: Calculates median, 20th percentile, 80th percentile, and price volatility.
Identifies historical min and max observed within rolling time windows (7d, 30d, 90d, 180d).
Handles sparse cohorts safely without fabricating smooth curves across data voids.

requirements.requirement: Deterministic deal detection and Deal Score calculation.
requirements.user_outcome: Users see clearly quantified deal strength reflecting real savings relative to historical norms.
acceptance: Deal Score is a bounded metric (0-100) combining discount percentage, historical percentile rank, and rarity.
Formula is deterministic, reproducible, and explainable.
Zero or negative discount results in Deal Score = 0.
required_evidence: Unit tests in src/app/domain/dealClaims.test.ts and flightIntelligence.test.ts

requirements.requirement: Strict separation of Deal Strength from Evidence Confidence.
requirements.user_outcome: Users are never misled by high discounts that lack sufficient historical verification or sample size.
acceptance: Confidence is calculated independently from Deal Score based on sample count, provider reliability, and observation age.
Fares with confidence < 50% are capped at modest labels (e.g. 'Giá đáng chú ý') regardless of high discount.
'Deal cực nóng' strictly requires confidence >= 75% and Deal Score >= 90.
'Deal rất ngon' strictly requires confidence >= 65% and Deal Score >= 80.
'Deal ngon' strictly requires Deal Score >= 70 and confidence >= 50%.

requirements.requirement: Suspicious data quarantine for anomaly containment.
requirements.user_outcome: Glitches, error fares below tax floors, and scraping anomalies are quarantined instead of triggering false deal alerts.
acceptance: Offers with prices below estimated airport tax minimums are quarantined.
Extreme price drops (>75% discount) with sample size < 3 require secondary verification.
Quarantined offers are excluded from top deal feeds and alert triggers until verified.
required_evidence: Validation rules in flight-normalization.ts and analyze-price

requirements.requirement: True-cost travel calculation engine.
requirements.user_outcome: Travelers see the real all-in cost of travel, including baggage, seats, and airport transit, not just the headline fare.
acceptance: Itemizes ticket fare, mandatory airport taxes, checked baggage, seat fees, payment surcharge, and airport transfer.
Classifies each cost component as KNOWN, ESTIMATED, OPTIONAL, or UNKNOWN.
Displays real total alongside advertised total with clear itemized breakdown.
required_evidence: Unit tests in src/app/domain/dealComparison.test.ts and flightIntelligence.test.ts
Playwright E2E verification of true cost in DealDetail

requirements.requirement: Foundational route optimization and candidate journey ranking.
requirements.user_outcome: Users discover optimal route combinations considering true cost, duration, and convenience tradeoffs.
acceptance: Evaluates direct vs 1-stop vs alternative hub routes.
Penalizes excessive layover times (>8 hours) unless intentionally selected as stopover.
Ranks route options by a multi-objective score balancing true cost, total duration, and transfer count.

requirements.requirement: Self-transfer and connection risk modeling.
requirements.user_outcome: Travelers booking separate tickets or tight connections receive clear risk disclosures and baggage re-check warnings.
acceptance: Detects self-transfer / separate-ticket connections and flags them with explicit warnings.
Evaluates connection buffer: flags layovers under 180 min (international) or 90 min (domestic) as HIGH RISK.
Detects airport changes (e.g. HND to NRT) and requires minimum 5-hour transfer buffer.
Categorizes risk into low, medium, high with concrete factors.
required_evidence: Unit tests in src/app/domain/routeOptimization.test.ts and flightIntelligence.test.ts

requirements.requirement: Deterministic Buy / Monitor / Wait decision engine.
requirements.user_outcome: Users receive clear, defensible advice on whether to buy immediately or wait, without false deterministic claims.
acceptance: Outputs decision categories: BUY_NOW, BUY_SOON, MONITOR, WAIT, or INSUFFICIENT_DATA.
Decision is strictly rule-grounded on price percentile, confidence score, lead time, and route volatility.
Does not claim guaranteed future prices when forecasting data is not statistically validated.

requirements.requirement: Grounded AI explanation with deterministic fallback.
requirements.user_outcome: Users get concise, plain-language insights explaining why an offer is a good deal, backed by real data facts.
acceptance: AI explanation prompt receives only structured, deterministic flight facts, statistics, and risks.
AI output is schema-validated (reason, tags, risk, recommendation, savingScore).
If LLM service is unavailable, fails, or violates schema, system falls back to rule-based explanation without disruption.
required_evidence: Normalization and fallback tests in src/app/data/api.test.ts

requirements.requirement: Ranked opportunity feed on homepage.
requirements.user_outcome: First-time and returning visitors immediately see fresh, high-value travel opportunities ranked by real savings.
acceptance: Homepage displays ranked opportunities prioritized by deal score, confidence, and diversity.
Suppresses duplicate flight cards for the same route and date.
Features distinct curated sections (e.g. Hot Deals, Biggest Price Drops, Recommended For You).
required_evidence: Unit tests in src/app/domain/travelFeed.test.ts and travelFeedSections.test.ts
Playwright E2E test verifying homepage feed cards

requirements.requirement: Comprehensive Deal Detail view.
requirements.user_outcome: Users inspecting a deal see complete transparency: route details, true cost, price history chart, risk rating, and verified booking link.
acceptance: Displays itinerary schedule, airline, flight number, duration, and stops.
Renders true cost analyzer with editable optional add-ons.
Renders interactive historical price chart when observations exist, or explicit no-data state when empty.
Displays grounded AI/rule explanation with clear provenance distinction (Fact vs Inference).
Provides validated booking handoff button.

requirements.requirement: Flexible opportunity discovery.
requirements.user_outcome: Travelers without a fixed destination can explore cheap trips by budget, continent, departure window, and max stops.
acceptance: Explore and Search pages support open destination filtering.
Filters include origin airport, budget ceiling, region (Southeast Asia, East Asia, Europe, Domestic), and date flexibility.
Filter state persists in URL query params or session storage.
required_evidence: Playwright E2E search and filter test

requirements.requirement: User travel preferences and personalized ranking.
requirements.user_outcome: Users configure their home airport, budget, and travel preferences to see tailored opportunities.
acceptance: Preferences include home origin, max stops, preferred airlines, budget limit, and risk tolerance.
Guest preferences persist in local storage; authenticated users sync to Supabase database.
Feed ranking personalizes deal order based on user preferences.

requirements.requirement: Saved deals with explicit lifecycle state tracking.
requirements.user_outcome: Users can bookmark deals and check back later, seeing immediately if the deal is still active, price has changed, or expired.
acceptance: Users can toggle bookmark on any deal card or detail page.
Saved deals page lists bookmarks with current lifecycle status (ACTIVE, PRICE_CHANGED, STALE, EXPIRED).
Never displays an expired or changed deal as current live fare without clear notice.
required_evidence: SavedDealsPage.tsx implementation and Playwright E2E test

requirements.requirement: Smart price alert creation with abuse protection.
requirements.user_outcome: Users can set targeted price alerts for specific routes or destinations with budget constraints and secure confirmation.
acceptance: Alert form supports origin, destination, max price, min discount, and date range.
Requires valid email or Telegram destination.
Protected by Cloudflare Turnstile verification and rate-limit budgets to prevent bot spam.
Requires confirmation token before alert activation.

requirements.requirement: Effectively-once notification dispatch and deduplication.
requirements.user_outcome: Users receive timely deal notifications without getting spammed with repeated alerts for the same offer.
acceptance: Alert processor matches published deals against active, confirmed user alerts.
Enforces 24-hour deduplication window per route/user to prevent spam.
Bounded retry policy (1m, 5m, 15m) for transient notification provider failures.
Provides one-click signed unsubscribe link in all notifications.

requirements.requirement: Freshness lifecycle and transparent freshness indicators.
requirements.user_outcome: Users always know exactly how old flight observations are and never trust stale data as fresh.
acceptance: Fares <= 120 minutes old are classified as HEALTHY.
Fares between 121 and 360 minutes old are classified as DEGRADED_FRESHNESS with warning badge.
Fares > 360 minutes old are classified as STALE_ONLY with prominent re-check prompt.
No endpoint or UI presents stale data as currently healthy.
required_evidence: DealCard.tsx freshness rendering and Playwright E2E freshness test

requirements.requirement: Responsive UX and accessibility compliance (WCAG 2.2 AA).
requirements.user_outcome: The application is fully usable across mobile and desktop devices, keyboard navigation, and screen readers.
acceptance: Touch targets for interactive elements meet or exceed 44x44px minimum.
Color contrast ratios meet WCAG 2.2 AA standards (minimum 4.5:1 for normal text).
Includes skip-to-content navigation link.
All icon-only buttons include accessible screen-reader labels.
Layout adapts cleanly between mobile viewport (375px) and desktop (1280px) without horizontal overflow.
required_evidence: Playwright desktop and mobile test execution in e2e/app.spec.ts

requirements.requirement: Zero secret leakage and strict environment isolation.
requirements.user_outcome: API keys, service role credentials, and internal secrets are never exposed to browser clients or committed to repository.
acceptance: Client bundle contains only VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY.
All privileged database writes, worker triggers, and provider calls reside in secure server/edge environments.
Automated secret scanning and security smoke test pass cleanly.
required_evidence: Node test in scripts/release-manifest.node-test.mjs and security-smoke.node-test.mjs
Code inspection of client build artifacts

requirements.requirement: Strict Row Level Security (RLS) and cross-user data isolation.
requirements.user_outcome: No authenticated or anonymous user can view or alter another user's personal alerts, preferences, or bookmarks.
acceptance: RLS enabled on user_preferences, user_bookmarks, price_alerts, and notification_logs.
Anonymous reads deny access or return empty sets for protected tables.
User A cannot read or write records belonging to user B.

requirements.requirement: Safe booking link sanitization and fail-closed affiliate redirects.
requirements.user_outcome: Users clicking booking links are safely directed only to approved airline or aggregator domains, protected against open redirects.
acceptance: Booking URLs are sanitized against a strict HTTPS allowlist of approved booking hosts.
Rejects javascript:, data:, or untrusted hostnames.
deal-redirect function validates deal status and affiliate parameters before emitting 302.

requirements.requirement: Transactional account deletion and data export rights (GDPR/Privacy).
requirements.user_outcome: Users can download their data and permanently delete their account with complete, transactional data removal.
acceptance: Authenticated export endpoint returns user preferences, bookmarks, and alerts with tokens scrubbed.
Server-authoritative account deletion requires explicit 'DELETE_MY_ACCOUNT' confirmation.
Transactionally deletes application records across all tables and logs one-way hashed deletion audit.
Fails closed without partial deletion if any step errors.

requirements.requirement: Automated data retention and hygiene cleanup.
requirements.user_outcome: Stale search caches, temporary snapshots, and anonymous event logs are routinely purged according to retention policy.
acceptance: Retention policy defines lifetimes: 7d for search cache, 30d for telemetry events, 90d for inactive alerts.
retention-cleanup function executes bounded batch deletions under internal secret authentication.
Dry-run mode supported for safe verification.

requirements.requirement: Provider health monitoring and circuit breaking.
requirements.user_outcome: When external flight data providers experience outages, FlyCheap degrades gracefully without crashing user interfaces.
acceptance: Monitors provider response codes, error rates, and empty responses in operational scan view.
Marks provider status (HEALTHY, DEGRADED, UNAVAILABLE).
Switches to cached/historical degraded mode when primary provider is unavailable.

requirements.requirement: High-throughput precomputed read models.
requirements.user_outcome: Homepage and deal search pages load quickly (<500ms) even with millions of raw historical fare records.
acceptance: Background refresh job precomputes ranked deal snapshots (refresh-observed-fares).
Public read endpoints query precomputed materialized read models with pagination and indexes.
Eliminates on-demand multi-table aggregate scanning on public user requests.
required_evidence: Edge function implementation in refresh-observed-fares and observed-fares

requirements.requirement: Structured observability, correlation IDs, and privacy-safe client diagnostics.
requirements.user_outcome: Operational errors are quickly diagnosable without exposing sensitive database or user details.
acceptance: All edge functions and API responses include x-request-id and x-release-sha headers.
Client error boundaries log bounded diagnostic error codes without leaking internal stack traces.
Client reports Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS) sampled at 25% without PII.

requirements.requirement: Reproducible database migrations and deployment runbook.
requirements.user_outcome: The system can be deployed and rebuilt from scratch on any clean PostgreSQL / Supabase instance without migration drift.
acceptance: All 38 SQL migrations replay in strict sequential timestamp order on clean PostgreSQL with 0 errors.
Automated CI validates migration chain integrity and linting.
Runbook provides unambiguous setup, test, migration, and verification instructions.

requirements.requirement: Adversarial test suite and failure resilience verification.
requirements.user_outcome: The system remains robust against corrupted payloads, extreme outliers, concurrent duplicates, DST boundaries, and network failures.
acceptance: Tests handle absurd prices ($0, negative, $1,000,000,000).
Tests handle timezone crossings and DST boundaries.
Tests handle provider timeouts, empty responses, and rate limit 429s.
Tests handle concurrent identical alert creation without duplicate notifications.
required_evidence: Adversarial unit and integration test executions across test suites
